notes: All existing mechanism IDs are preserved. The new workflow module covers the concrete evidence-based financial integration and PASS-controlled revision, not the generic generator–critic pattern. The two role selectors remain one mechanism, with scoring and online update merged. Only decision_support is assigned; forecasting baselines are excluded. Task performance is evidenced by reported directional hit rate, while returns and risk measures establish decision utility. Process validity remains false: case studies illustrate decisions, but no runtime success/failure validation is reported. Temporal validity reflects the reported chronological, availability-restricted protocol, not an independent leakage audit. Generic tools, frozen backbones, baseline adapters and evaluation preprocessing are not promoted into separately contributed modules.

reconciliation.reason: Sections 4.3 and E.3 describe outcome-attributed memories and recurring lessons used across later interactions, supporting Optimization and Evolution. The shared cases preserve context but do not themselves implement scheduling. Settling risk-warning correctness and revision profitability is task-specific outcome evaluation, not a chronology, leakage or temporal-consistency guard. The conditional evidence-based trading workflow in Section 4.2.2 is separately usable, as the memory-free reference in Appendix B shows, and receives its own new module.
